name: poly-getting-started
description: Getting-started tutorial and starter project for building on PolyAPI at Covetrus.

scripts.models:generate: poly model generate src/apiFunctions/jokeApi.openapi.yaml src/apiFunctions/jokeApi.model.json --context covetrus2.demo2 && poly model generate src/apiFunctions/adviceApi.openapi.yaml src/apiFunctions/adviceApi.model.json --context covetrus2.demo2
scripts.models:validate: poly model validate src/apiFunctions/jokeApi.model.json && poly model validate src/apiFunctions/adviceApi.model.json
scripts.models:train: poly model train src/apiFunctions/jokeApi.model.json && poly model train src/apiFunctions/adviceApi.model.json
